pkgname.description: Package name (from .cabal file name). Required to derive package identities.

version.description: Package version (override via --version=VERSION or inferred from .cabal).

name.description: Explicit package name override (from --name=NAME). Empty to auto-generate.

architecture.description: Target architecture (e.g., any, all, amd64). Controlled by Cabal build flags but not exposed as CLI flag; set via --ghc/--jhc/etc. defaults.

build_deps.description: List of build dependency groups (each item is a list of package names for a dependency clause). Derived from Cabal build-deps, adjusted per compiler (ghc/nhc/jhc/hugs).

description_short.description: Short one-line description of the package.

description_long.description: Long multi-line description (will be indented properly in final control file).
